description: This file implements system-level functions and glue code for the Arctic Core AUTOSAR platform, including file operations, memory management, and hardware abstraction.

methods.name: fileno
methods.description: Returns the file number associated with a FILE pointer.

methods.name: _OPEN
methods.description: POSIX open function that maps filename to device file descriptors.

methods.name: _FSTAT
methods.description: Provides file status information, here mocked as character device.

methods.name: _KILL
methods.description: Stub for kill, sets errno to invalid argument.

methods.name: _ISATTY
methods.description: Returns 1 indicating the file descriptor is connected to a terminal.

methods.name: _SBRK
methods.description: Memory management function for heap extension.

methods.name: _READ
methods.description: Reads data from a file descriptor.

methods.name: _WRITE
methods.description: Writes data to a file descriptor.

methods.name: _LSEEK
methods.description: Seek operation not supported, returns error.

methods.name: _exit
methods.description: Terminates the program, calls ShutdownOS and loops infinitely.
